notes.title: Fantasy ERA 23/11/2017 UPDATE NOTES
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30183970/4648db286cc8ba5f6ebcd253c42dda1a37fcdb8f.png
ADD : 14 new characters and 2 new building added.
ADD : Chat feature was activated.
ADD : Main menu, exit and back buttons added.

FIXED : Artificial intelligence improvements done.
FIXED : The viewpoint of the camera has been enlarged.
FIXED : Bug fixed in warrior spawn building.
FIXED : Workers' bugs were removed.
FIXED : The bugs of the trees were removed.
FIXED : Bridge bugs fixed.
FIXED : The views of workers and warriors have been raised.
FIXED : Map bugs fixed.
FIXED : Worrior damage system upgraded.

 It will also be added soon in Steam Achievements and new music.

Access to the game will be opened within 24 hours. (Oyuna erişim 24 saat içinde açılacak.)
